name: modex-monorepo
description: Modex — an open, Codex-App-style desktop app that runs Claude Code and Codex through their CLIs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @modex/core && npm run build -w @modex/desktop && npm run build -w @modex/site
scripts.test: npm run test -w @modex/core && npm run test -w @modex/desktop && npm run test -w @modex/site
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @modex/desktop && npm run test:e2e -w @modex/site
